cues.en: Welcome to Section two Introduction to Fraud Detection.
cues.zh: 歡迎來到第二章：詐欺偵測簡介。

cues.en: This is lecture four.
cues.zh: 這是第四堂課。

cues.en: What is fraud detection?
cues.zh: 什麼是詐欺偵測？

cues.en: So by means of a definition, fraud detection is the process of detecting anomalous financial records
cues.zh: 從定義上來說，詐欺偵測就是從大量正常交易中，

cues.en: from within a broader set of normal transactions.
cues.zh: 找出異常金融紀錄的過程。

cues.en: We assume that a financial services organization, if they operating effectively, the majority of their
cues.zh: 我們假設金融服務機構運作正常時，大部分

cues.en: transactions, would and should be normal in the sense that they're not fraudulent.
cues.zh: 交易都會、也應該是正常的，也就是不涉及詐欺。

cues.en: Although fraud does creep into many and most organizations in some way or form.
cues.zh: 不過，大多數組織仍會以某種形式受到詐欺影響。

cues.en: And fraud detection is the act of actually attempting to detect those suspicious transactions from within
cues.zh: 詐欺偵測就是嘗試從這片正常交易的汪洋中，

cues.en: the sea of of normal transactions.
cues.zh: 辨識出可疑交易。

cues.en: The data is typically tabular in nature, meaning that it has rows and columns.
cues.zh: 資料通常是表格形式，也就是有列與欄。

cues.en: So you can think of data within an Excel spreadsheet, for example, as being tabular data, assuming it has a rows and column structure to it.
cues.zh: 例如 Excel 試算表中的資料，只要具有列與欄的結構，就可以視為表格資料。

cues.en: Although fraud detection does occur in other domains as well, you could take a text based approach.
cues.zh: 當然，詐欺偵測也可能使用其他類型的資料，例如以文字為基礎的方法。

cues.en: There's a lot of work around graph techniques and graph neural networks.
cues.zh: 圖形技術與圖神經網路也有許多相關研究。

cues.en: But the majority of the transactions are captured in a tabular sense, and it's very important for us
cues.zh: 不過，大多數交易仍以表格形式記錄，而對我們來說，

cues.en: to have a access to historical instances of confirmed fraudulent behavior as these end up acting as
cues.zh: 取得過往已確認的詐欺案例非常重要，因為這些紀錄最終會成為

cues.en: our target variable or our labels for our data.
cues.zh: 資料的目標變數或標籤。

cues.en: These are often tricky to get hold of as they are generally generated by a third party, which could
cues.zh: 這些資料往往不容易取得，因為通常由第三方產生，例如

cues.en: be a bank or another financial services provider.
cues.zh: 銀行或其他金融服務業者。

cues.en: And the turnaround for these transactions, ions or other these labeled transactions can be quite timely.
cues.zh: 而這些交易，或者說這些交易標籤，取得的週轉時間可能相當長。

cues.en: So it can take up to 60 days for some banks, I guess, depending on where you are in the world, for them to actually confirm whether something was fraudulent or not.
cues.zh: 某些銀行可能需要多達 60 天，才能確認一筆交易是否涉及詐欺，實際情況也取決於所在國家。

cues.en: So you can imagine that if you've got a fraud detection process or model running and you want to evaluate
cues.zh: 所以可以想像，如果你有正在執行的詐欺偵測流程或模型，想要即時評估

cues.en: the effect of effectiveness of it in real time, it is difficult to figure out what the actual ground
cues.zh: 它的成效，就很難確認實際的真實標籤，

cues.en: truth is purely because it takes so long for you to get that that confirmed record back from the bank.
cues.zh: 原因就在於銀行回傳確認紀錄需要很長的時間。

cues.en: And because fraud is by definition less frequent than normal behavior within an ecosystem, naturally
cues.zh: 而且在一個系統中，詐欺行為本來就比正常行為少見，

cues.en: you're going to end up with far less confirmed frauds relative to normal or good behavior, and therefore
cues.zh: 所以已確認的詐欺案例自然遠少於正常或良好行為，

cues.en: leading to what we call an imbalance between the fraudulent and non fraudulent samples.
cues.zh: 因此會造成詐欺與非詐欺樣本之間的類別不平衡。

cues.en: Is that means that if you look at all of the non fraudulent samples, you add them up, you look at all the fraudulent samples, add those up.
cues.zh: 意思就是，把所有非詐欺樣本加總，再把所有詐欺樣本加總，

cues.en: The non fraudulent or the normal transactions are going to outnumber the fraudulent transactions by an order of magnitude and more.
cues.zh: 正常或非詐欺交易的數量，會比詐欺交易多一個數量級，甚至更多。

cues.en: Feature engineering is also crucial in fraud detection, and it typically involves conversations and
cues.zh: 特徵工程在詐欺偵測中同樣非常重要，通常需要與

cues.en: interactions with domain experts, whether that's you as a data scientist or a fraud analyst or a fraud
cues.zh: 領域專家討論及互動，不論是資料科學家、詐欺分析師，還是詐欺

cues.en: investigator, and taking those insights and that domain knowledge and transforming that into data points
cues.zh: 調查人員，再把這些洞見與領域知識轉換為資料特徵，

cues.en: that can be used to detect suspicious behavior.
cues.zh: 用來辨識可疑行為。

cues.en: Right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And these features that we use within models, they are typically aggregated at the customer level or
cues.zh: 模型使用的特徵，通常會依應用情境，在客戶層級

cues.en: at the transaction level, depending on the use case, and some approaches might even combine the two.
cues.zh: 或交易層級進行彙整，有些方法甚至會結合兩者。

cues.en: So what we mean by aggregated at the customer level, we can look at the customer's transactional behavior over time.
cues.zh: 所謂客戶層級的彙整，就是觀察客戶隨時間變化的交易行為。

cues.en: Aggregate those things up and say, for example, how many transactions have the customer made over
cues.zh: 把這些資料彙總起來，例如這位客戶在整個往來期間、

cues.en: their lifetime or over the last six months, over the last seven days, over the last 24 hours, that kind of thing.
cues.zh: 最近六個月、最近七天或最近 24 小時內，各做了多少筆交易。

cues.en: And then at the transaction level there, the data is aggregated at a different level and a customer can have multiple transactions.
cues.zh: 交易層級則是在不同的層次彙整資料，而且一位客戶可以有多筆交易。

cues.en: So you might have multiple records for a single customer, which is fine, but in that case you're trying to detect fraud at that at that transaction level.
cues.zh: 因此，同一位客戶可能對應多筆紀錄，這沒有問題，只是此時你是在交易層級偵測詐欺。

cues.en: But you could even augment transaction level data with customer level data.
cues.zh: 不過，也可以用客戶層級資料來補充交易層級資料。

cues.en: So you can say, well, for each of these transactions, but the corresponding customer who actually
cues.zh: 也就是針對每一筆交易，看看實際進行該交易的客戶，

cues.en: made that transaction, what was their spending habits over the last 30 days, seven days, 24 hours, etcetera.
cues.zh: 在過去 30 天、七天、24 小時等期間的消費習慣。

cues.en: Then network data is also important within fraud detection.
cues.zh: 此外，關聯網路資料對詐欺偵測也很重要。

cues.en: So that's data that tells us how users within a system are connected to each other if they are connected at all.
cues.zh: 這類資料能告訴我們，系統中的使用者是否彼此相連，以及如何相連。

cues.en: And it's normally quite a strong indicator of fraudulent behavior.
cues.zh: 這通常是相當有力的詐欺行為指標。

cues.en: So if you've got customers within your ecosystem who are very closely linked via devices or IP addresses
cues.zh: 如果系統中的客戶透過裝置、IP 位址

cues.en: or credit cards, these kinds of things, typically that's not normal behavior.
cues.zh: 或信用卡等資源緊密相連，通常不是正常行為。

cues.en: It might be normal, maybe within a family context, maybe within an organization of sorts.
cues.zh: 當然，在家庭或某些組織的情境下，這可能是正常的。

cues.en: If there's sharing of those kinds of resources.
cues.zh: 因為他們可能共用這些資源。

cues.en: But by and large, from a single customer perspective, that's quite abnormal behavior.
cues.zh: 但一般而言，從單一客戶的角度看，這種行為相當不尋常。

cues.en: But looking at that data point alone wouldn't be enough to tell you whether something was suspicious or not.
cues.zh: 不過，光看這一個資料點，還不足以判定是否可疑。

cues.en: Rather, you would use that in conjunction with other information that is presented to you.
cues.zh: 應該與你掌握的其他資訊一起判斷。

cues.en: And data sets for fraud detection are notoriously difficult to access due to various issues related
cues.zh: 由於資料隱私方面的各種問題，詐欺偵測資料集

cues.en: to data privacy.
cues.zh: 向來很難取得。

cues.en: You know, companies not wanting to give their trade secrets away or simply, you know, enough of it hasn't been kind of published within the public domain.
cues.zh: 例如公司不願洩漏商業機密，或只是公開領域中尚未發布足夠的資料。

cues.en: Luckily, there are some popular datasets that are available online, one of them being the ULB Machine
cues.zh: 幸好，網路上仍有一些常用的公開資料集，其中之一就是 ULB Machine

cues.en: Learning Group credit card fraud dataset that has been published on Kaggle and that we will be using throughout this course.
cues.zh: Learning Group 在 Kaggle 發布的信用卡詐欺資料集，也是本課程接下來會使用的資料。
